title: The Third Side

mathematics.rationale: sol_scene.py lines 16–27 preserve exact 3:4:6 proportions with one uniform scale. The triangles share AC; both markers lie in the correct planes. The calculations d²=25, d=5, L²=61, L=√61≈7.81 and edge sum 13 are correct. AD joins opposite corners and lies strictly inside the box except at its endpoints. Shortestness correctly uses the straight-connection fact separately from the numerical comparison.

presentation.rationale: The sampled frames show readable typography, safe margins, no clipping or collisions, consistent color mapping, translucent triangles and visible right-angle markers. The subdued scaffold communicates the enclosing volume while the interior diagonal dominates. frame_12.png retains both triangles and the exact/approximate result. Source scheduling totals 40 seconds, includes a 3.5-second final hold, and places geometry before equations. Text uses Segoe UI and camera changes use the requested APIs.

The faint captions in frame_01.png and frame_03.png are consistent with scheduled fades; they do not establish a persistent legibility defect.
